caption: The drawing features two depictions of the same object: a human-like figure. On the right side, there is a shaded, three-dimensional rendering of a dark-colored sculpture. This figure has a smooth surface and stylized proportions, including a rounded head, distinct facial features, bent arms resting on the chest, and bent, arched legs forming a wide base. The left side shows a simple, non-shaded line drawing of the same figure, providing a front view with visible facial details, arms folded across the chest, and legs apart in a “V” shape. Below this line drawing is a horizontal scale divided into one-inch increments labeled "INCHES." Both objects are set within a rectangular border on a light tan background, giving the composition a structured layout.
title: Andiron
